game: CIN@GB Week 6 2025, kickoff 2025-10-12 16:25 ET, Lambeau outdoors, GB -14, total 44.5 (nflverse games.csv closing line in pack)

script.base: Green Bay is a 14-point home favorite with a 29.2 implied total and should lead by halftime, then grind the clock with Josh Jacobs (61 carries, 200 yards in the weeks 2-4 block). Cincinnati's implied total is 15.2. J.Browning is the QB in the rusher sample (7 carries, 39 yards over weeks 3-5); Joe Burrow does not appear in the pack. Browning's offense is already negative (EPA/db -0.34 unblitzed, -0.15 vs blitz) and GB blitzes only 20%, so CIN mostly sees its worse split. CIN falls behind and abandons the run. Total 44.5 is not a shootout. Chase Brown's rush volume is the casualty; CIN dropbacks rise, but GB has allowed only 6 passes of 20+ (166 yards) in 4 games, so extra air yards do not reliably become yards.
script.flip1: CIN stays within a score into the fourth: Ja'Marr Chase (questionable, illness) plays, Browning avoids a cascade of negative drives, and GB's OL (Anthony Belton out; Aaron Banks, Rasheed Walker, Jacob Monk, Zach Bako-Bewele questionable) cannot sustain the run. Both teams stay pass-heavier, Jacobs never gets the full clock-kill count, and Brown keeps an early-down carry share instead of being scripted out.
script.flip2: GB is up 21+ by halftime and sits Jordan Love and Jacobs. Emanuel Wilson (14 carries, 69 yards in weeks 2-4) vultures fourth-quarter carries. CIN garbage-time throws inflate Chase, Tee Higgins, and Mike Gesicki while Brown's rush line is already dead. The -14 spread is the blowout flag: starters' late snaps are at risk.

CIN also bleeds outside (left 7.91 on 69, right 8.07 on 73) and has allowed 18 passes of 20+ for 187 yards; middle is CIN's best zone (6.14 on 35).

GB's rush overlap is Jacobs into CIN's 4.50 YPC / 13 explosive runs. Kraft (16 targets, 209 yards, only 57 air) attacks CIN's stronger middle. Doubs (15/111/179) and Wicks (14/84/214) overlap CIN's outside bleed, but Watson was already off the weeks 2-4 target list.

data_check.notes: No projection, no sims, no Pinnacle no-vig, and no book price in the pack, so the edge gate (model p must beat no-vig by 3+ points) cannot be run and nothing can be sized. Directional form agrees with the strong read: last-three rush games 3, 40, 27 all under 40.5, and 3 of last 4 (47, 3, 40, 27) are under, empirical 0.75. That 0.75 sits in the 70-80% band the skill says has hit near 50%, so treat model_p as a last-4 hit rate, not a calibrated sim, and do not size up. Wyatt Out is a news counter, not a stat that already contradicts 3.66 YPC. Dropped leans, not cut strong reads: Josh Jacobs rush over 75.5 (script and CIN 4.50 YPC / 13 runs of 10+ agree, but last4 66, 84, 30, 86 is 2-of-4, weeks 2-4 efficiency is 3.28 YPC, Belton Out plus four OL questionables, and the -14 late-snap flag; form does not clearly agree, so the lean is dropped). Jacobs rush+rec over 79.5 is the same bet plus a 4-yard receiving cushion the market barely prices, and last4 rec 4, 0, 44, 71 is too volatile. Tee Higgins rec under 32.5 has agreeing form (15, 32, 22) and GB outside YPA ~5.2 with 6 explosives in 4 games, but the dog-throws-more script plus Chase questionable is a counter at least as strong, so it is dropped. Chase rec 50.5 is a pass while he is questionable and last3 is 50, 23, 110. Kraft, Doubs, Wicks, Wilson, Perine, and Gesicki do not clear a one-sentence edge that survives the base script and a flip without a stronger counter.

pre_mortem: It is Monday and Brown rush under lost. Wyatt was out and Cincinnati ran at the backup interior while the game was still neutral, before Green Bay pulled away. Brown's 47-yard game in the last four shows 40.5 is clearable when the script is not a chase. Lee and Fairchild both played, Patrick's absence was absorbed, and 12 carries at even 3.5 YPC is 42. Or flip 1 happened: GB's own OL questionables kept it close, CIN never abandoned the run, and one of the six 10+ runs GB has allowed plus a short day cleared the number. That counter is real. It is not stronger than the base read, because he needs both a script flip and an efficiency bounce off 2.5 YPC against a 3.66 YPC front. The leg stays, flagged for the human on Wyatt and on the unpriceable 0.75, not cut.
slip_story: One story: favorite leads and runs the clock, dog abandons the run. The only leg is Chase Brown rush yards under. A correlated Jacobs rush over would be the other side of that story but failed the lean gate (efficiency, OL, blowout snaps, no price). Do not add CIN pass overs (Chase, Higgins, Gesicki); those need the pass-volume or garbage-time flip, the opposite of a rush-under ticket. No TD legs, no second market on Brown (rush+rec can be saved by checkdowns if rush dies). Main slip is this one leg until a price exists. Weather was not saved, so no wind/rain leg was added.
